sections: Scope

documents.title: Daily check of Offset Printing Press
documents.purpose: Find small problems early, before they stop the machine.

documents.purpose: Keep the machine clean, lubricated and adjusted.

documents.title: Maintenance of Forklift Truck (Support)
documents.purpose: Keep the forklift truck (support) safe and available by defining who does which maintenance task, how often, and how it is recorded.
sections: Scope
Applies to: FKL-01 Doosan Forklift 3 Ton. Machine specifics (limits, intervals, lubrication charts) follow each manufacturer manual.
Responsibilities
Operator: does the Daily Check (WI-MNT-FKL-01) every shift and reports problems as a Maintenance Request.
Technician: carries out the weekly and monthly care (WI-MNT-FKL-02, WI-MNT-FKL-03) and breakdown repair (WI-MNT-FKL-04) through a Preventive or Breakdown Maintenance Order.
Head of maintenance: approves orders, closes them, and keeps this procedure and its work instructions current.
Safety
Wear the protective equipment required for this machine. Never bypass a guard, interlock or emergency stop.
Only trained and licensed operators may drive the forklift.
Never carry people on the forks and never exceed the load rating plate.
A damaged forklift must be tagged out of service until repaired.
Legal inspection of lifting equipment applies: keep the certificates current.
Before any work inside the machine, isolate it with lock-out and tag-out as in the work instructions.
Procedure
Daily: WI-MNT-FKL-01 by the operator, recorded in Daily Check.
Weekly: WI-MNT-FKL-02 by the technician, recorded in a Preventive Maintenance Order (PMO).
Monthly: WI-MNT-FKL-03 by the technician, recorded in a PMO.
Breakdown: WI-MNT-FKL-04, recorded in a Breakdown Maintenance Order (BMO) started from a Maintenance Request.
Records
Daily Check sheet, Preventive Maintenance Order, Breakdown Maintenance Order, Maintenance Request.
Machine documents (manual, vendor contact) in the Asset Maintenance Profile.
Review
This procedure is reviewed at least once a year and after every serious breakdown or accident.
